note: Both sets capture the filter type, discrete time step, corner frequency and the Bode-plot endpoint values, but Set A introduces three inconsistent readings of the same endpoints (-72 deg, -80 deg, -12.5 dB) and repeats the 0.01 Hz values twice. Set B keeps the endpoint values consistent with the plot (-12 dB, -75 deg) and adds correct range statements, though it also carries one -80 deg and one -12.5 dB misread plus two vague trend claims. Set A additionally reads the phase at 0.10 Hz (~-30 deg) correctly, but its extra wrong and duplicated claims outweigh that. Neither set extracts the state-space matrix definitions (A_d = alpha, B_d = 1-alpha, C_d = alpha, D_d = 1-alpha) or the one-quarter-of-first-edgewise-natural-frequency relation.
remarks: Both sets quote the figure caption as evidence for specific plotted values, which the caption alone does not support; the values must be read off the plotted curves. The -80 deg and -12.5 dB claims in both sets contradict their own -75 deg / -12 dB claims and the axis labels, suggesting a noisy chart-reading step. Important facts both sets miss: the discrete-time state-space matrices A_d = alpha, B_d = 1-alpha, C_d = alpha, D_d = 1-alpha, and the stated relation that the 0.25 Hz corner frequency is roughly one-quarter of the blade's first edgewise natural frequency.
